macros.name: index
macros.doc: Redefine \index to specify into which file/index the term is to be placed.

macros.name: makeindex
macros.doc: Redefine \makeindex to create a new .idx file with the name provided by argument #1.

macros.name: printindex
macros.doc: Redefine \printindex to specify the file to be included; provide an alternate command \Printindex that specifies both the file and the index title to be printed.
